text:
Here is my answer to 'tell me about a time you fixed a production issue'.
Situation: In my last role our checkout service started timing out during the Eid sale, and support tickets tripled within an hour.
Task: I was the on-call engineer that night and owned getting checkout healthy again before the evening traffic peak hit us.
Action: I pulled the Grafana dashboards, traced the slowdown to an unindexed query on the orders table, and shipped an index behind a feature flag after confirming the plan on a replica.
Result: p95 checkout latency dropped from 4 seconds back to 300 ms within twenty minutes, and we closed the sale with no further incidents. Afterwards I wrote a short runbook so the next person could diagnose it faster.
Situation: Our team inherited a reporting pipeline that broke almost every month and nobody fully understood it anymore.
Task: My manager asked me to make the monthly finance report reliable without a big rewrite we had no time for.
Action: I added logging at each stage, reproduced the failure on sample data, and found a timezone bug that dropped the last day of each month. I fixed it, wrote tests around the boundary, and documented the flow.
Result: The report has run cleanly for eight months since, and finance stopped chasing us at month-end, which freed up roughly a day of my time each cycle.
